patches.expected_old: Inherited loadability and documentation assessment; spatial fit rescored for this EEZ. Most of the Gilbert Islands EEZ lies within the published 110-180 E, 15 S-15 N warm-pool model domain. Its small portion east of the dateline is outside. Use only as an oceanic basin proxy; national PPR and reef fisheries are not resolved. Bibliographic/spatial correction:  Primary WCPFC landing lists downloadable SC3_EB_IP8.pdf. Bounds explicitly 110–180°E and 15°N–15°S; not blanket western-central Pacific EEZ coverage. Primary 42-page 2007 report Section 2.2 explicitly states fixed 110–180 E,15 N–15 S; Section 2.3 states 31 final functional groups. Do not conflate with later 44-group 140–180 E/10 N–15 S warm-pool models. Report includes parameter, diet and catch tables; no native model file verified.
patches.proposed: Original 42-page 2007 source audited: 31 final groups, parameter/diet/catch tables, mixed input periods and eight imports. Source reconstruction FAIL is distinct from selected accepted juvenile PB/EE Option1 WARN; strict mass balance remains false. Raw missing catches differ from genuine source zeros; multistanza translation, loader and detritus assumptions remain explicit. Regional review covers 63 labels, including two zero-catch unresolved labels and weak coastal/reef analogues. The fixed 110–180 E / 15 S–15 N rectangle is distinct from the changing warm-pool Figure 1; A about 99.7%, B about 3.9–4.6% with denominator uncertainty. No native author EwE database recovered. Legacy numerical quality scores are retained and have not been reassessed.
evidence: Exact selected model and primary-source identities match reviewed HS071; regional counts and geography remain EEZ941-specific.
